texts.Excited to work in-person?: Yes - I prefer in-person; I'm regularly in Palo Alto.
texts.Why Parallel?: Parallel is building the web layer that agents actually need - I feel this pain daily as an operator: I run a production multi-machine Claude fleet whose routines live and die by the quality of programmatic web access. Cloud partnerships is the seat where that conviction meets my trade: 15+ years of founder/BD work building distribution through platforms and partners, and cloud marketplaces are where AI infrastructure gets bought now. Turning a great API into default infrastructure on the AWS/GCP/Azure shelves is a concrete, winnable distribution game I want to run.
texts.Why you?: I have done both halves of this job. Partnerships: 15+ years founder/BD - co-founder of Platinum VC & Incubator, 10,000+ founder calls, enterprise advisory for subsidiaries of Foxconn and ANA Airlines, government/bank relations across SE Asia; I build partner programs end-to-end, from first call to signed terms to operational playbooks. Product side: I am a hands-on agent operator - production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines), MCP connectors, RAG over a 10-year knowledge base, 100+ routines, published reliability evals - so I can speak with platform engineers in their language. On an active US O-1 (no sponsorship needed), regularly in Palo Alto, available immediately.
